Wanderings and Ways, Volume III The truths and lies revealed to Mistelroth were many, for his journey to the void gate was long and perilous, filled with both friend and foe.
《漫游与道途》 第三卷 向米斯特罗斯显露的真相与谎言数不胜数，因为他前往虚空之门的旅程漫长而凶险，友与敌交织其间。
res#60465/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Start

On this particular journey, he met an entity. Some say he also met himself. These words are worth heeding, whether you be peasant or king.

     Mistelroth stopped before an archway. It shimmered with color, echoes of his past and future swirling beneath it. An entity sat before him. Colorless. Formless. And yet undeniably present.

就在这一次旅程中，他遇见了一个存在。有人说，他也遇见了自己。这些话值得听取，无论你是农夫还是国王。

     米斯特罗斯在一座拱门前停下。拱门流光溢彩，他过去与未来的回声在门下翻涌。一个存在坐在他面前。无色。无形。却又分明在场。
res#60465/whatIHaveToSay[2]
Start

It spoke, ''Time is a misdirection; distance a veil to obscure the truth. Grasp the silver cord, and dispel all illusion.''

     Mistelroth grasped the silver cord, now visible stretching from his body through the arch and into the distance. He pulled himself forward, then hesitated, staring into the turbulent colors of his life that swirled across the archway.

它开口了，''时间是误导；距离是遮蔽真相的面纱。握住银线，驱散一切幻象。''

     米斯特罗斯握住了银线，此刻它清晰可见，从他体内延伸出去，穿过拱门，直入远方。他把自己向前拉去，却又迟疑了，凝视着拱门上翻卷激荡、属于他一生的色彩。
res#60465/whatIHaveToSay[3]
Start

He saw newly discovered joys, and mistakes repeated again and again. He traced illusory patterns with his eyes. He relived them with his gaze.

     Fear gripped him, and he readied himself to rush through the archway. He stepped forward, and again hesitated; not out of fear, but from a sudden clarity. He discerned a flaw in his thinking. A lie he was about to tell himself.

他看见了新觅得的欢愉，也看见一再重演的过失。他用目光描摹那些虚幻的纹样，用凝视将它们重温。

     恐惧攫住了他，他准备冲过拱门。他迈步向前，又再次迟疑，不是因为恐惧，而是源于一阵突如其来的清明。他察觉了自己思维中的破绽：一句他正要对自己撒的谎。
res#60465/whatIHaveToSay[4]
Start

Would he deny his past and future? Would he flee from his choices? He saw the error in denying the life he had lived, and in rejecting a future that may already be set, though he knew it not what it held. He stopped in the archway, embracing the turbulence. A past unchangeable and a future determined were still both the result of his choices.
他能否认自己的过去与未来吗？他该逃避自己的选择吗？他看清了：否认自己活过的人生是错的，抗拒一个或许已然注定、而他并不知其内容的未来，也是错的。他停在拱门之中，拥抱那份激荡。不可更改的过去与已然注定的未来，同样都是他选择的结果。
res#60465/whatIHaveToSay[5]
Start

He could not, would not, deny his own volition. He had choices left to make, though he saw a glimpse of where they might lead.

     The swirling mass of his life faded, and through that archway he could see an endless void. A new archway opened beside him, and the cord snapped towards the new arch, as if it had always been there.

他不能，也不愿否认自己的意志。他仍有选择要做，尽管他瞥见了这些选择可能通向何方。

     他人生翻卷的画卷消退了，透过那座拱门，他能看见无尽的虚空。一座新的拱门在他身旁敞开，银线骤然绷向新的拱门，仿佛它一直都在那里。
